```{r}
library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)
con <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "purchase.sqlite")
```

```{sql connection=con}
select *
from purchase
```
## Questão 1
```{sql connection=con}
select PNO, SUM(COST) AS Custo_Total
from purchase
group by PNO
```

## Questão 2
```{sql connection=con}
select ENO, sum(cost) as Custo
from purchase
group by ENO
```

## Questão 3
```{sql connection=con}
select PJNO, ENO, sum(cost) as custo
from purchase
group by PJNO, ENO
order by PJNO, ENO
```

## Questão 4
```{sql connection=con}
select PNO, SNO, sum(cost) as custo
from purchase
group by PNO, SNO
order by PNO, SNO

```

## Questão 5
```{sql connection=con}
select PJNO, ENO, SNO, sum(cost) as custo
from purchase
group by PJNO, ENO, SNO
order by PJNO, ENO, SNO
```
## Questão 6
```{sql connection=con}
select PNO, SNO, ENO, sum(cost) as custo
from purchase
group by PNO, SNO, ENO
order by PNO, SNO, ENO
```
## Questão 7
```{sql connection=con}
select PJNO, ENO, SNO, sum(cost) as custo
from purchase
where PJNO <> 'PJ2'
group by PJNO, ENO, SNO
```
## Questão 8
```{sql connection=con}
select PNO, SNO, ENO, SUM(cost) as custo
from purchase
group by PNO, SNO, ENO
having custo >= 2000
```
